pattern: the controller of {o:Obj} sacrifices it , then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal {f:DiscardDesc}
subject: none

examples.text: The controller of target creature sacrifices it, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles all other cards revealed this way into their library.

The controller of target land sacrifices it, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles all other cards revealed this way into their library.

counterExamples: The owner of target creature sacrifices it, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card.
The controller of target creature sacrifices a land, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card.
The controller of target creature sacrifices it, then reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal two creature cards.
